jobs.title: Senior MERN Stack Developer
jobs.job_description: We are hiring a Senior MERN Stack Developer to build secure, scalable web applications. The developer will work across React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB, design REST APIs, write TypeScript/JavaScript, use Git, test features and collaborate with product and design teams. Minimum 3 years of full-stack software development experience is required. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related field is preferred. Experience with Docker, AWS, Jest and CI/CD is desirable.
